quote: Forty-three minutes. I kept watching the timer because there was nothing else to watch. No windows. No sound. Just the coil tick and my own breathing and the knowledge that somewhere behind the wall there was nothing — no air, no light, just the Atlantic floor at four thousand meters. Then the deceleration, and then Rotterdam. I don't know what I expected transit to feel like. Not like being swallowed.
source: Anonymous first-transit account, collected by Vellichor Institute Mobility Studies program, 2218
context: First-time Pulse rider, Tier 2 research assistant on sponsored access
